hook_line: YASH WORE RAVANA COSTUMES WEIGHING UP TO 33 KG IN RAMAYANA

hook_stat.sub: Weight of Yash's heaviest Ravana outfits in Ramayana

stats.label: Typical weight of Yash's Ravana costumes, including jewellery
Weight of Ravana's crown, even after repeated attempts to lighten it

diaspora_bullets: Ramayana Part 1 is now playing in the US and UK
news_summary: Costume designer Saniya Sardhariya told India Today that Yash's costumes as Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana typically weighed 16 to 20 kg including jewellery, with the heaviest outfits close to 30 to 33 kg.
payoff: Sardhariya said Yash kept a cheerful atmosphere on set despite the weight.
